caption:
Same takeaway night, slightly smarter order.

The latest National Diet and Nutrition Survey found that around 23% of our energy now comes from food eaten outside the home, mostly takeaways and fast food. Small choices on the menu add up when it's a weekly habit.

Grilled, tandoori and stir-fried usually beat battered, creamy and deep-fried. One veg side on every order helps too.

Save this for your next takeaway night, and send it to whoever does the ordering in your house.

#Fakeaway #TakeawayNight #FoodSwaps #HealthyEatingUK #UKWellness

variants.hook: Did you know almost a quarter of our calories now come from food eaten from outside the home?
That korma you order every Friday, one swap on the menu makes a real difference.
